title.value: Memory Efficient Neural Processes via Constant Memory Attention Block
title.justification: This is the title of the paper
title.quote: Memory Efficient Neural Processes via Constant Memory Attention Block

extractions.description: The paper introduces Constant Memory Attentive Neural Processes (CMANPs), a memory-efficient Neural Process variant that uses a novel attention block requiring constant memory, making it suitable for low-resource settings. It achieves state-of-the-art results on NP benchmarks with improved memory efficiency.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on improving the memory efficiency of neural networks, not directly addressing sustainable development themes.

primary_category.justification: The primary focus is on memory efficiency in neural networks, which is an infrastructure or enabling technology rather than a direct application of sustainable development.

primary_sub_category.justification: The work is about improving efficiency, not about any specific Climate or Ecologically-Related Sustainable Development subcategory.

applications.justification: The paper mentions the growing popularity of low-memory/compute domains (e.g., IoT devices and mobile phones).
applications.quote: With the growing popularity of low-memory/compute domains (e.g., IoT devices and mobile phones), deployed models in these low-resource settings must be memory efficient.
